description:
Port the upstream pi-mono extension test suite and example extensions into octo_pi. The extension infrastructure (Extension behaviour, Dispatcher, API, EventBus, Loader, etc.) was built in Phase 6 (octo-3gv) with two reference extensions (DirtyRepoGuard, InputTransform). This epic stress-tests that infrastructure by porting the upstream's full test battery and a representative set of example extensions, flushing out gaps and incompatibilities.

Upstream sources:
- Test machinery: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/test-harness.ts (446 lines, faux model + session factory)
- 6 extension test files (~1400 lines, ~100 test cases)
- 2 integration/regression test files (~420 lines)
- ~60 example extensions in tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/

Already ported: DirtyRepoGuard, InputTransform (octo-3gv.6). Existing Elixir extension infra: Extension, API, Dispatcher, Context, EventBus, Loader, RuntimeState, TelemetryHandler, ToolRender, UIContext, CommandContext, ProviderConfig.
title: [EPIC] Port extension examples + test machinery from upstream
